title: NVIDIA Partners With Mistral AI to Accelerate New Family of Open Models
description: Today, Mistral AI announced the Mistral 3 family of open-source multilingual, multimodal models, optimized across NVIDIA supercomputing and edge platforms. Mistral Large 3 is a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model — instead of firing up every neuron for every token, it only activates the parts of the model with the most impact. The result is efficiency […]

title: NVIDIA and AWS Expand Full-Stack Partnership, Providing the Secure, High-Performance Compute Platform Vital for Future Innovation
